title: Loxone Audit Entry Action Code Leaderboard
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=loxone:audit action_code=*
| stats sum(action_code) as total_value, avg(action_code) as avg_value by user_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks user values by total and average action code across Loxone audit entry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `action_code` values for each Loxone audit entry event and review total and average action code by user.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total action code.
grandmaExplanation: It usefully which user shows the biggest action code numbers in your Loxone audit entry data.
